posts.title: Sheats–Goldstein / John Lautner
posts.description: The Sheats–Goldstein Residence by John Lautner (1963-1994) This year I was able to check two big ones off the list. It was the Stahl House and now this. The Sheats–Goldstein Residence was originally just the Sheats House. It was built in 1963 for Paul and Helen Sheats. It changed hands a few times and James Goldstein bought it in 1972. Source: Julius Shulman © J. Paul Getty Trust. Getty Research I
